messages:
Nico: Heads up — after the route-resolver v2 canary (10%) started ~10m ago, invoice-preview for a couple of tenants shows ~0 token usage even though requests are flowing. link: https://console/redwood/invoice-preview/tenant/studio-x :eyes:
Anya: saw this too for 4 tenants, all on the same route tag. Looks like `route_id` is missing from billing events downstream.
Raj: deploy-bot shows canary kicked at 1715009500. deploying -> route-resolver:v2 @ 10% canary.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for route-resolver:v2 -> 10% (id=cr-2026-03-22-001)
metering-bot: Sample event (ingest): { tenant: "studio-x", tokens: 412, route_id: null, trace_id: "t-9f3" } — attribution dropped at proxy.handoff
Sasha: quick triage: either router stopped stamping `route_id` header or the enrichment step strips unknown tags. simple query to confirm: 
```
SELECT count(*) as missing, tenant
FROM billing_events
WHERE route_id IS NULL
AND ts > now() - interval '30 minutes'
GROUP BY tenant
ORDER BY missing desc
LIMIT 20;
```
Nico: that query already returns 4 tenants with >100 missing events each.
Anya: POI — console invoice preview currently hides "unattributed" tokens (defaults to zero). UX ask: show a separate line item called "Unattributed tokens (possible routing issue)" so PMs can see at-a-glance when canaries blow up attribution.
Raj: short-term mitigation: router can emit fallback tag `route_id="__unknown__"` instead of null, that keeps counts but surfaces bucket. I can push a tiny proxy change. downside: will increase invoice-preview totals until we fix attribution.
Sasha: prefer fallback tag + console line item; avoids silent zeroing. Also add a synthetic metric: `metering.attribution.fail_rate` per-tenant so we can alert fast.
Nico: agreed. Alert proposal: fire when fail_rate > 0.5% for a tenant over 15m, and block canary ramp past 10% until fail_rate < 0.1% for 2h. Put gating in rollout policy config: 
```
rollout_policy:
  metric: metering.attribution.fail_rate
  threshold: 0.1
  hold_duration: 7200  # 2h
  initial_canary: 10  # percent
```
Anya: I'll add the invoice-preview UI change (small label + helptext) and a toggle to include/exclude unattributed tokens. Filing UX ticket and will link PR.
Raj: I can get proxy PR today: attach `X-Route-ID: __unknown__` when resolver returns empty. Will also log `attr_failure=true` into the trace. PR: https://git/repo/pull/1456
metering-bot: Query sample after fallback tag applied (10:05): tenant=studio-x, unattributed=438, total=12,834 -> unattributed 3.4%
Nico: we'll accept that transient bump. Important is visibility and alerts.
Sasha: follow-ups: (1) add `metering.attribution.fail_rate` metric + dashboard card, (2) add console invoice-line, (3) proxy PR + canary gating, (4) backfill script to re-run enrichment for last 2h events if we can recover route mapping.
Anya: assigning tasks — PRs: #1456 (Raj), #1459 (Anya console), #1460 (Nico alert). I'll put a note on the rollout and pause further ramps until PRs land.
deploy-bot: Canary paused for route-resolver:v2 (id=cr-2026-03-22-001) — hold reason: attribution anomalies detected.
Raj: I'll push the proxy patch to staging and keep the canary paused. If anyone wants to triage with me: ping me in-thread or DM.
Nico: thanks — good catch. We'll use this as a checklist for future router rollouts: attribution visibility + synthetic metrics must exist before >10% canary.
Anya: logging this as postmortem-lite in the ticket. short-term owner: Raj, console owner: Anya, alerts/ops: Nico.
Sasha: also recommend a sample-sink that mirrors raw pre-enrichment events for 1% of traffic during rollouts — easier bisect. I'll draft that in a follow-up. :+1:
Nico: OK closing the thread here; will follow up with PR links and dashboard mocks.
